headline: Awards outran tenders 53 to 21 this week
hook: Awards outran tenders 53 to 21 this week, so the work is moving to subcontract and supply packages. Today: NGED's $796M substation civils framework, Scatec's 900 MW Shadwan and a Sarawak FSRU.
board: Of 92 new projects in 51 countries, 53 were awards and 21 were tenders. Energy accounted for 60 and Europe for 39.
question: Would you pitch the NGED framework contractors or Scatec's Shadwan build first?

items.headline: NGED substation civil works framework, 132kV to 11kV, United Kingdom
items.statLabel: Framework value awarded by National Grid UK
items.what: National Grid UK has awarded a civil works framework for 132kV, 66kV, 33kV and 11kV substations on the NGED distribution network, covering new and refurbished substation sites, per UK Find a Tender.
items.who: Owner: National Grid UK Limited. Contractors: A I & Z A Grant, Alpha Construction, Alun Griffiths, Amalgamated Construction and others.
items.angle: This is an awarded framework, so the next step is subcontracting by the named contractors. That opens work for suppliers of cable ducts, fencing, drainage and building materials, and for crews who can work in live substations.
facts: The lot in the notice covers the NGED network zones of Redruth and Bodmin
Works will often be carried out in a live substation environment
Scope also covers building maintenance: roofs, glazing, joinery, trench covers, doors and gates
items.watch: Call-offs under the framework. The notice says these may include protecting substations from flooding, high winds and high humidity.

items.headline: Shadwan 900 MW onshore wind project, Egypt
items.statLabel: Total capex, 900 MW Shadwan onshore wind
items.what: Scatec, in partnership with EDF power solutions, has started construction of the 900 MW Shadwan onshore wind project in Egypt, Scatec announced on 1 October 2026.
items.who: Owner: Scatec with EDF power solutions. EPC: Not named in the report. Scatec says it will deliver the project through its integrated model.
items.angle: Construction has started on one of Africa's largest onshore wind farms, per Scatec. Scatec is using its own D&C activities, so equipment and construction subcontractors should approach Scatec directly.
facts: Scatec signed equity bridge loans totalling USD 150M with The Arab Energy Fund
A joint development agreement with EDF targets a 29% equity stake in Shadwan
Expected output is about 4 TWh a year, avoiding an estimated 1.6m t of CO2 a year
items.watch: Scatec says it intends to invite additional equity partners into the project.

items.headline: FSRU-based LNG import terminal, Sarawak, Malaysia
items.statLabel: Hoegh Evi–Petros deal reported by LNG Prime
items.what: Hoegh Evi and Petros have signed a deal to jointly develop an LNG import terminal in Malaysia's Sarawak state, LNG Prime reports.
items.who: Owner: Petros and Hoegh Evi (joint developers). EPC: Not named in the report.
items.angle: This is a joint development deal, not a construction award. It is early, so FSRU, marine and regasification suppliers can follow it, but no scope or value has been reported yet.
facts: LNG Prime describes Hoegh Evi as a Norwegian FSRU player
Petros is Sarawak's state-owned oil and gas company
The terminal will be FSRU-based, per LNG Prime
items.watch: Details of capacity, site and schedule. None appear in the available LNG Prime text, which is paywalled.
